verdict.rationale: Baseten is an API-driven inference platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair ask, but the evidence pack never documents one. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI and Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt docs index and the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints are not a machine-readable spec of Baseten's own API. The spec could still exist at an unprobed path, which is why confidence is medium rather than high.
